disable._note: A lethal hit on a defence (a Turrets71 def or any t7 turret) leaves it disabled at hp_frac*max hp instead of destroying it; a second lethal hit while disabled destroys it. One hit of >= jam_hit_frac of max hp jams it for jam_s. Engineers revive in revive_s, maintenance drones in drone_revive_s.

walls._nanite_resist_note: PROVISIONAL (BASTION71-7): a nanite_coat wall takes x0.6 damage from Machine-owned shooters (Walls71.nres_mult, called by Damage.apply_hit)

doze._note: PROVISIONAL (BASTION71-7): breacher dozer doze_clear: arrive within reach, remove one Gore71 body / wreck within clear_r every clear_s
